title: Easy Beginner Crochet Baby Blanket Video Tutorial
description:
In this video, I demonstrate an easy beginner crochet blanket stitch that I love to use for baby blankets.  This fun stitch builds up quickly and only requires that you repeat one row, which makes is great for beginners.  You can find the full pattern as well as list of materials for this baby blanket on the Leelee Knits Website at the link below.

https://www.leeleeknits.com/easy-beginner-crochet-baby-blanket/
